sentences.text: Imagine Dragons is an American rock band from Las Vegas , Nevada , consisting of lead vocalist Dan Reynolds , lead guitarist Wayne Sermon , bassist Ben McKee , and drummer Daniel Platzman .	Daniel Platzman	Daniel Platzman	Ben McKee	Ben McKee	Dan Reynolds	Dan Reynolds (musician)	Wayne Sermon	Wayne Sermon	Las Vegas	Las Vegas	Nevada	Nevada	rock	Rock music
The band first gained exposure in 2012 with the releases of their debut studio album Night Visions and its first single `` It 's Time '' .	Night Visions	Night Visions	single	single (music)
Billboard placed them at the top of their `` Year In Rock '' rankings for 2013 , and named them their `` Breakthrough Band of 2013 '' .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

Rolling Stone named their single `` Radioactive '' from Night Visions the `` biggest rock hit of the year '' , and MTV called them `` the year 's biggest breakout band '' .	rock	Rock music	Night Visions	Night Visions	single	single (music)	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone	Radioactive	Radioactive (Imagine Dragons song)	MTV	MTV
Night Visions peaked at number two on the weekly US Billboard 200 chart and the UK Albums Chart .	Night Visions	Night Visions	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)	UK Albums Chart	UK Albums Chart
The band 's second studio album Smoke + Mirrors was released in 2015 , and reached number one in the US , Canada and the UK .	Smoke + Mirrors	Smoke + Mirrors

Imagine Dragons has won two American Music Awards for Favorite Alternative Artist , a Grammy Award for Best Rock Performance , five Billboard Music Awards , and a World Music Award . In May 2014 , the band was nominated for a total of fourteen different Billboard Music Awards , including Top Artist of the Year and a Milestone Award , which recognizes innovation and creativity of artists across different genres .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)	Billboard Music Awards	Billboard Music Awards
As of January 2017 , Imagine Dragons have sold 9 million albums and 27 million singles worldwide .
